name: Sustainability of Production Systems and New Dynamics in the Cocoa Sector
programme: DeSIRA (Development Smart Innovation through Research in Agriculture)
description:
Cocoa4Future aimed to improve the environmental, agronomic and socio-economic sustainability of cocoa production systems in Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana. The project sought to support the agroecological transition of the cocoa sector by identifying, evaluating and promoting efficient, resilient and diversified cocoa agroforestry systems adapted to local environmental and socio-economic conditions.

Research activities combined agronomy, forestry, ecology, plant health and social sciences to assess the performance of different cocoa production systems, including their productivity, biodiversity, ecosystem services, climate resilience and contribution to farmers' livelihoods. Particular attention was given to tree diversity and management, soil fertility, shade regulation, carbon storage and the control of cocoa diseases, notably Cocoa Swollen Shoot Virus.

At farm and value-chain levels, the project investigated opportunities to diversify production, improve household incomes, strengthen farmer organisations and promote quality-oriented and environmentally responsible cocoa value chains. Through participatory research involving farmers, cooperatives, research institutions and other stakeholders, Cocoa4Future developed practical knowledge and innovations to support more sustainable cocoa production while reducing pressure on forests and natural resources.
